articles.title: What Would it Take for AI to Benefit Young Workers? Fortt Knox Innovation Lab
articles.description: On CNBC Innovation Lab, Jon Fortt spoke with CNBC's Brandon Gomez and Steve Liesman, and Ground Level AI's Sharon Goldman about AI's impact on the entry-level workforce. Cognizant is hiring young workers to fast-track them to mid-level via AI, but Liesman warned gutting entry jobs blocks experience-building. A KPMG internship revamp, the rise of solopreneurs and driverless food delivery all pointed to one fix: management must retrain itself, even as AI's real limits stay unknown.
